description:
Role Name: .Net Programmer Bill: $60/h 
 Location: Denver, CO 
 Duration: 8+ Months 
 
 Write or design computer programs, applications or systems, or software packages by coding instructions and algorithms into computer-readable form. Experience in software design, development, installation, integration, evaluation, enhancement, maintenance, testing and/or problem diagnosis/ resolution. Test, debug, document and implement computer programs, applications, or software packages, as well as maintain existing computer programs by making modifications as required. As an analyst, confer with clients regarding the nature of the business need or issue to be addressed. Must have excellent abilities to effectively communicate technical information to non-technical personnel, both orally and in writing. Design, enhance, maintain/support databases, or coordinate work with database administrator. 
 Knowledge and skill sets include ASP.NET (desired use of various versions, including 2.0, 3.5 and 4.5.x) for front end (web applications) and middle (Web services/Consoles). Other desired components are MVC v3+, C#, and SQL database knowledge. 
 
 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
